proposition: Ibn Turka wrote to Iskandar's chief vizier Ghiyās al-Dīn Ḥāfiẓ Rāzī (letter 12, ca. 816/1413) praising his regard for religious leaders and scholars and asking his help in installing Sharaf al-Dīn Yaʿqūb as qadi; he wrote again after Iskandar's fall (letter 43), a brief well-wishing to a man then mainly occupied with teaching.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Vazīr Ghiyās al-Dīn Ḥāfiẓ Rāzī
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
